title: Bible Anywhere: find, compare and quote the Bible on Mac, iPhone and iPad
description: Press ⌃⌥B in any Mac app, type a reference and press Return: the verses are copied with their references. Two translations side by side, cross references, highlights and notes, read aloud. Offline, no account. Free to read, one-time Pro.
hero_p: Press ⌃⌥B in Pages, Word, Obsidian or an email, type “John 3:16; Rom 8:28” and press Return. The verses are copied with their references, ready to paste.
hero_note: Reading, search, two translations, highlights, notes and read aloud are free. On the Mac, copying from Quick Find is part of Pro; on iPhone and iPad, Pro removes the ads.
cta_soon: Coming soon to the App Store
requirements: macOS 14 or later · iOS and iPadOS 17 or later · Korean and English
how_h2: Three ways it saves you time
steps: Type one reference or several (“Ps 23; 1 Cor 13:4-7”), or a few words. Return copies them in the style you chose.
Read two translations side by side, open cross references next to the text, and come back to the verse you left.
Gather verses for a sermon, lesson or study on the shelf, drag a card into your document, or copy them all at once.
features_h2: Made for people who write with Scripture
features: Reference after or before the text, a Markdown quote, an Obsidian callout, the reference in parentheses, or one verse per line for slides.
Five highlight colours, a note on any verse, bookmarks for the places you return to. Notes belong to the verse, so they show in every translation.
The chapter read with the voices built into your device, offline, with the verse being read marked and followed. It goes on into the next chapter.
Copy Link reopens the passage from Notes, Pages or Obsidian. Select a sermon outline and the Services menu puts each line's verses right under it.
118,000 links from OpenBible.info. Select a verse to see related passages, preview them and jump with one tap.
Reading themes for long sessions and a Myeongjo or old-style serif face, with every text size you need.
⌘F to search, ↑↓ to move between verses, ←→ to change chapters, ⌘L to go to a reference. Every command is in the menu.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Every text is on your device and works without a connection.
devices_p: The same texts, search, cross references, highlights and notes. Tap verses to copy, share or mark them; on iPad the two translations sit side by side. Free on iPhone and iPad with a small banner below the text; Pro removes it.
devices_note: Highlights, notes and bookmarks are kept on each device for now.
pricing_h2: Free to read. Pay once for the tools.
free_price: Mac with no ads · iPhone and iPad with a small banner
free_items: Read aloud, themes, copying from the reader, verse links
pro_price: US$4.99 once · no subscription · Family Sharing
pro_items: Mac: copying from Quick Find in any app
Mac: Services menu to insert verses where you write, Markdown export
One purchase works on Mac, iPhone and iPad
pricing_note: No paywall at launch. The Pro window always has Close and Restore Purchases.
texts_note: All four are in the public domain. Copyrighted translations such as NIV, ESV, NASB, 개역개정 and 새번역 need a publisher's license and are not included.
promise_p: There is no account and the app never sends your notes anywhere. The Mac app has no ads and no tracking. On iPhone and iPad a Google AdMob banner pays for the free version, without asking to track you; Pro removes it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Bible Anywhere is a Bible app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. It is built to work without collecting any personal information.
sections: Bible Anywhere has no account, no analytics and no crash reporting service, and the developer receives no data from the app.

On iPhone and iPad only, the free version shows banner ads from Google AdMob. Google's ad SDK collects device and advertising data, an approximate location from the IP address, and diagnostics to show and measure ads. The app does not ask to track you, so your advertising identifier is not used. Where the law requires it (for example in the EEA and UK), you are asked for consent first and can change it later in Settings ▸ Ad Privacy Settings. Buying Pro removes the ads. See Google's privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
The Mac app shows no ads and collects nothing.

Your settings, reading position, shelf, highlights, notes and bookmarks are stored in the app's own folder on your device. They never leave it unless you copy, share, drag or export them yourself. Deleting the app deletes them.

The Bible texts and cross references are inside the app, so reading, searching and read aloud work offline. The Mac app makes no network requests of its own; on iPhone and iPad the only network use is the ad banner.
Bible Anywhere Pro is bought through the App Store. Apple processes the payment and tells the app only whether Pro is unlocked. See Apple's privacy policy for how Apple handles purchase data.
The app collects no data from anyone, including children.
If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new date. Questions: {email}
privacy.note: This policy applies to the Bible Anywhere apps and this website. The website uses no cookies, analytics or third-party resources.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Questions, bug reports and ideas are welcome: {email}. Please include your device, its system version and what you were doing.
faq: The Quick Find shortcut does nothing on my Mac.

Another shortcut may already use it. If macOS uses it (for example ⌃⌥Space switches input sources), Settings shows a warning; choose a different shortcut in Bible Anywhere ▸ Settings ▸ General. Another app's shortcut cannot be detected, so try a different one if Quick Find still does not open.
How do I restore Pro on a new Mac?
Open Settings ▸ General and click Restore Purchases, signed in with the same Apple Account. With Family Sharing, family members get Pro too.

On the Mac: reading, search, two translations, cross references, highlights, notes, bookmarks, read aloud, themes, copying from the reader and verse links. Pro adds Quick Find copying, the Services menu and Markdown export. On iPhone and iPad every feature is free with ads, and Pro removes the ads.
Is the iPhone and iPad version really free?
Yes. Every feature is free with a small banner below the text. Pro (one purchase) removes the ads; if you bought Pro on the Mac, tap Restore Purchase in Settings.
Do my highlights and notes sync between devices?
Not yet. They are kept on each device. Syncing through iCloud is planned.
Why is NIV, ESV or 개역개정 not included?
Those translations are copyrighted and need a license from their publishers. Bible Anywhere includes only public-domain texts.
English or Korean book names and common abbreviations all work: “John 3:16”, “Rom 8:28-39”, “Ps 23”, “요 3:16”, “고전 13:4~7”. Separate several with semicolons.
No. All texts, cross references and the read-aloud voices are on your device.
